The issuer displays severe financial distress, evidenced by negative EBIT (-$780M) and net income (-$1,088M), alongside an extremely high leverage profile with total liabilities of $20,101M against a thin equity base of $706M. While the company maintains scale and liquidity to meet short-term obligations, its current burn rate and thin capital buffer place it at high risk of restructuring or default in the medium term. Consequently, these credit metrics align with a highly speculative, single-B rating.

DECISION: B-
